2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A and other allied Sections of the Indian Penal Code and other 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Allegedly, the petitioner, who is the husband of informant is said to have assaulted the informant and also ousted her out of her matrimonial house on the pretext of non- fulfillment of demand for dowry.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and have committed no offence.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.
No such occurrence, in the manner as alleged, has ever taken place.

Petitioner has never Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.42885 of 2022(8) dt.18-09-2023 made demand for dowry from the informant.
He further submits that earlier the petitioner filed a divorce case thereafter the informant filed the present case.
